SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JAN-15-2020 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JAN-15-2020 BY A. JAMES ROBERTSON II. PLAINTIFF DEREK BLUFORD IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT BARBARA LANG (INCORRECTLY NAMED AS BARBARA LONG) IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
DECLARATION OF BARBARA LONG RE: CORRECTION OF NAME (MINUTES OF 01/15/20 HEARING) FILED BY DEFENDANT LANG, BARBARA
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-15-2020 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BLUFORD, DEREK RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT LANG, BARBARA $10,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $235.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $10,235.00, DEFENDANT DROVE INTO PLAINTIFF'S PARKED SPORTS CAR. COURT FINDS REPAIR COSTS OF $6,532.00, RENTAL CAR EXPENSES OF $1,795.00 AND DIMINSHED CAR VALUE OF $1,673.00. TOTAL OF $10,000.00. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED APR-01-2020 ORDERED DESTROYED
AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY BLUFORD, DEREK AS TO DEFENDANT LANG, BARBARA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-15-2020 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
